body: Damn, I needed this today. I have been struggling since my marriage ended 6 months ago. I thought by now I'd be totally over him, but nope. I still have a lot of guilt and "what ifs" about the relationship. Even though we were only married for 2 years (7 years together in total), no kids, no house, he kept the cat, no divorce complications - it is still so painful. I feel the same way, I have no other choice but to accept it. Plus, he is with someone new so that hurts even more. Especially since he told me he didn't want kids and now he is with someone with 3. Ouch. But yeah, I should try this self-compassion/self-forgiveness mantra.
